items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Yeah, Henny Brunis, he was Dixieland man.

ctx.x: What about these other fellas? Were they Dixieland trombone players? Who was that? The ones that you were talking about, like Henny Brunis.
Yeah, Henny Brunis, he was Dixieland man.
